document_metadata.title: 1、EXT. BEAUTIFUL HOUSE - FRONT DOOR - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Micky visits his daughter Kasie unannounced, promises better future after his upcoming fight, but Laurie denies access, leading to a brief emotional exchange through the door before she closes it.

entities.name: Micky arrives at Laurie's home and knocks on the door
entities.description: Micky approaches the house and knocks, initiating an encounter with Laurie and her husband Jimmy.

entities.name: Jimmy answers the door and speaks with Micky
entities.description: Laurie's husband Jimmy opens the door and quietly converses with Micky, expressing surprise at his unannounced visit.

entities.description: Laurie approaches and questions why Micky is at her home, stating it is not his scheduled visitation day.

entities.name: Micky explains he wants to see Kasie before next weekend
entities.description: Micky tells Laurie he wishes to say hello to their child Kasie because he will not be available the following weekend.

entities.name: Laurie accuses Micky of skipping his visitation days
entities.description: Laurie reacts angrily, interpreting Micky's absence next weekend as another instance of him neglecting his parenting responsibilities.

entities.description: Micky explains that he has a scheduled fight, which conflicts with his visitation time, and mentions this to Jimmy.

entities.summary: A boxer navigates personal and professional challenges, including a fight against Mike 'Machine Gun' Mungin, family tensions, facial injuries post-loss, and an offer to train in Las Vegas, while emotionally relying on his absent brother Dicky.

entities.description: The daughter of Micky and Laurie, whom Micky wants to see before next weekend.
entities.summary: Micky Ward's 10-year-old daughter, who lives with him and Charlene in Lowell, is the daughter of Micky and Laurie. She is involved in a high jump activity, depicted in family photos, and her exposure to an HBO documentary causes tension between Micky and Laurie.

entities.name: Micky promises Kasie he will make more money after winning the fight
entities.description: Micky tells Kasie that after he wins his upcoming fight, he will start earning more money and plans to move to a bigger apartment so she can stay with him more often.

entities.name: Laurie dismisses Micky's promise and warns Kasie not to believe him
entities.description: Laurie interrupts Micky's conversation with Kasie, scoffs at his promise, and tells Kasie not to hold her breath, accusing Micky of misleading her.

entities.name: Laurie closes the door and argues with Jimmy inside
entities.description: After the exchange with Micky, Laurie shuts the door and begins arguing with Jimmy inside the house.

entities.name: Kasie shouts good luck to Micky through the door
entities.description: After the door is closed, Kasie calls out to her father through the door to wish him good luck in his fight.

entities.name: Micky shouts thanks to Kasie through the door
entities.description: From outside, Micky responds to Kasie's shout by thanking her through the closed door.

entities.name: Alice confronts Charlene about Dicky's role in Micky's training
entities.description: Alice argues with Charlene, insisting that Micky needs Dicky as his trainer and that Dicky only wanted the best for him, escalating the tension between the two women.

entities.name: Charlene reveals Dicky is in prison
entities.description: Charlene laughs and points out that Dicky cannot train Micky because he is currently incarcerated, undermining Alice's argument and intensifying the conflict.

entities.name: Micky questions his mother's favoritism toward Dicky
entities.description: Micky challenges Alice about why she always prioritizes Dicky, expressing frustration over the damage Dicky has caused despite being a good trainer.

entities.name: Alice lunges at Charlene in a fit of rage
entities.description: After Charlene insults Dicky and implies danger to Micky, Alice physically attacks Charlene, showing her emotional volatility and protective instincts.

entities.name: Micky restrains his mother and stops the confrontation
entities.description: Micky intervenes to prevent Alice from reaching Charlene, asserting his authority and protecting Charlene from physical harm.

entities.name: Red Dog and Beaver attack Charlene in a bar fight
entities.description: Red Dog attempts to hit Charlene, who fights back by grabbing Red Dog's face and shoving her, then backhanding Beaver who is pulling her hair, leading to a chaotic physical altercation.

entities.name: Micky breaks up the fight and restores order
entities.description: Micky releases his mother and shouts to stop the violence, ending the physical confrontation between Charlene and the other women.

entities.name: Alice breaks down in tears after the fight
entities.description: Overcome with emotion, Alice cries and expresses confusion and despair about the deteriorating relationships among her family members.

entities.name: Red Dog and Beaver comfort Alice and escort her to the car
entities.description: After the fight, Red Dog and Beaver support Alice emotionally and physically by putting their arms around her and walking her away from the scene.

entities.name: George sees Alice and her sisters and drives away in fear
entities.description: George arrives in his roofing truck, recognizes Alice and her daughters, becomes visibly scared, and quickly leaves without engaging.

entities.name: Micky knocks down Luis Castillo with a right uppercut and hook combination
entities.description: During a boxing match, Micky lands a short right uppercut followed by a hook, causing his opponent Luis Castillo to fall to the canvas and lose the fight.

entities.name: Referee stops the fight after Castillo fails to recover
entities.description: After Luis Castillo stumbles while trying to rise from the canvas, the referee waves the fight over, officially ending the match in Micky's favor.

entities.name: Hometown crowd erupts in celebration of Micky's victory
entities.description: The standing-room-only audience at the Sheraton Inn in Lowell explodes into cheers and screams upon Micky's win, marking a triumphant moment in his career.

entities.name: Micky raises his hands in victory without seeing Dicky in his corner
entities.description: For the first time in years, Micky celebrates a win by raising his hands, but notices his brother Dicky is absent from his corner, creating an emotional contrast to the victory.

entities.name: Micky O'Keefe enters the ring to hug and whisper to Micky
entities.description: Trainer Micky O'Keefe climbs through the ropes after the fight to embrace Micky and deliver a private message, symbolizing his new support role.

entities.name: Charlene and Sal LoNano celebrate Micky's win ringside
entities.description: Charlene and Sal LoNano cheer loudly for Micky during and after the fight, showing their support from ringside.

entities.name: Dicky receives a visitor announcement over the prison loudspeaker
entities.description: While at the Bay State Correctional facility, Dicky Ecklund hears his name called over the loudspeaker for a visit, interrupting his solitary run.

entities.name: Dicky walks alone on the prison track in quiet reflection

entities.name: Sanchez collapses and crawls on the canvas after taking a body shot
entities.description: Sanchez, severely injured from a powerful body shot, falls to his hands and knees and crawls across the ring in pain while the referee begins counting him out.

entities.name: Referee Halpern counts Sanchez out
entities.description: Referee Halpern administers a count over the incapacitated Sanchez, reaching at least seven, signaling that Sanchez is close to being knocked out.

entities.name: Micky celebrates victory after Sanchez fails to rise
entities.description: After seeing Sanchez unable to continue, Micky runs to a neutral corner and jumps in the air with arms raised in triumph, marking his victory in the fight.

entities.name: Charlene erupts in celebration shouting 'FUCK YEAHHHHHHH'
entities.description: Charlene jumps up and down, shouting exuberantly in celebration of Micky's victory, expressing intense emotional release and pride.

entities.name: Alice reacts in shock declaring 'HE DID IT! BODY SHOT! IT'S OVAH!'
entities.description: Alice, wide-eyed and stunned, exclaims that Micky has won the fight with a decisive body shot, confirming the end of the match.

entities.name: Dicky screams in triumph proclaiming 'MY BRUTHAH DROPPED SANCHEZ!'
entities.description: Dicky, overcome with excitement, shouts from the crowd that his brother Micky has knocked down Sanchez, fulfilling his earlier prediction.

entities.name: Prisoners and guards erupt into cheers
entities.description: In a moment of shared excitement, both prisoners and guards in attendance abandon their roles momentarily and celebrate Micky's victory together.

entities.name: Mickey O'Keefe hugs and jumps with Micky in the ring
entities.description: Mickey O'Keefe enters the ring and embraces Micky, jumping up and down with him in an emotional celebration of the victory.

entities.name: Sal LoNano and George celebrate in Micky's corner
entities.description: Sal LoNano and George rush into Micky's corner, joining the celebration and showing their support after Micky's successful fight.

entities.name: Charlene cries and laughs while jumping in celebration
entities.description: Overcome with emotion, Charlene alternates between crying and laughing as she jumps up and down, expressing joy and relief at Micky's win.

entities.name: Micky pushes Sal LoNano away after being hugged
entities.description: When Sal LoNano attempts to hug him, Micky abruptly pushes him off, showing discomfort or distrust toward Sal despite the celebration.

entities.name: Micky kneels and crosses himself in his corner
entities.description: In a moment of personal reflection and gratitude, Micky drops to one knee and makes the sign of the cross, blood still dripping from his face.

entities.name: Micky strikes Dicky in the head during a confrontation
entities.description: After Dicky is already on one knee from being hit in the kidney, Micky delivers a powerful straight right to the back of Dicky's head, causing him to slam face-first onto the canvas with blood flowing from his nose.

entities.name: Dicky expresses determination to continue fighting
entities.description: Despite being injured and reprimanded, Dicky gets up and declares he can go ten more rounds, asserting his identity as a fighter by claiming 'I'm Shea Neary' and challenging Micky to work him.

entities.name: Micky asserts his need for personal agency in his career
entities.description: Micky confronts Alice, expressing frustration that his fight should be about him for once, not overshadowed by Dicky's past glory, emphasizing Dicky's age and physical decline.

entities.name: Alice apologizes to Micky and expresses remorse
entities.description: Alice runs to Micky after he begins to leave, embraces him, and tearfully apologizes, admitting she didn't understand her actions, promises to do better, and declares her love for him.

entities.name: Dicky storms out after emotional confrontation
entities.description: Following the heated exchange, Dicky throws his gear down in anger, causing folding chairs near the cake table to fall, and exits through the main door, signaling his emotional withdrawal from the situation.

entities.name: Micky Ward and Shea Neary exchange aggressive blows in the first round
entities.description: In the opening round of the fight, Neary attacks with fast body shots, while Micky responds with short uppercuts and a left hook to the ribs, leading to a close exchange of punches forehead-to-forehead in the ring.

entities.name: Shea Neary lands multiple body punches on Micky Ward

entities.description: After taking heavy blows, Micky responds with a sequence of hook and uppercut combinations, demonstrating resilience and offensive capability despite the pressure.

entities.name: Micky Ward is nearly knocked out of the ring by Neary's attack
entities.description: Neary's aggressive offense drives Micky backward, causing him to sprawl into the ropes and almost fall out of the ring, barely held up by the ropes.

entities.name: Micky Ward struggles to maintain balance and is advised to stay still
entities.description: With his legs unsteady and visibly hurt, Micky attempts to hold on while George Foreman comments that Ward should remain still to recover, indicating his compromised condition.

entities.name: The first round ends with the bell as Micky remains on unsteady feet
entities.description: Despite being out on his feet and stumbling, Micky survives until the bell rings to end the first round, marking a dramatic conclusion to the initial three minutes.
